newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal sees 13-17 pct '97 net growth.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal sees 13-17 pct '97 net growth.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc said Thursday it has a high degree of confidence that it will achieve 13 to 17 percent earnings growth in 1997 on eight percent sales growth.
AlliedSignal said profit and sales growth will come from new products, plant capacity increases and improving conditions in several businesses.
The company said it expects its engineered materials unit to resume sales and earnings growth in the second quarter.
Sales at the electronic materials portion of the unit were lower because of the inventory correction in the printed wiring board industry, which now appears to be completed, AlliedSignal said.
In 1996, AlliedSignal earned $1.020 billion or $3.61 per share on revenues of $13.971 billion in revenues.

Earlier, the company reported 1997 first quarter earnings of $259 million or $0.92 a share on revenues of $3.327 billion versus earnings of $225 million or $0.80 per share on revenues of $3.778 billion a year ago. The 1996 first quarter included a light vehicle braking business which was sold in April 1996.
